notes: The figures and claims below are the report's own. Volunteer figures are inconsistent: the Letter to Shareholders says service hours 'exceeded 80,000 hours, averaging 9.9 hours per person', while section 4.5 reports 88,319 hours at 9.7 hours per person; the section 4.5 figure was used. Local Revitalizer+ launched in 2024 and is operating, so it is current. Its figures of 15,000+ service hours and NT$10 million+ revenue appear right after a page break in the same paragraph as the 34-teams sentence; if the figure check treats them as a separate paragraph, the 34-teams count alone still supports level 3. The 'Co-creation with youth' pillar of the Inclusiveness Project (training local youth and elders to start businesses) is the same activity family as E4 and was not counted again. The creativity evidence is thin: one board-recusal agenda item recording a donation to the affiliated KGI Cultural and Arts Foundation, with no amount given. 'Local creative teams' and 'cultural revitalization' are mentioned only within the revitalization program. CDIB Capital's venture/PE investing (e.g., cooperation agreements to strengthen investment in AI startups) was treated as the group's investment business, not a specific enabling program. Accessible online-banking functions appear only in forward plans and were not scored. Other disclosures were noted but not scored as cross-cultural activity: elderly-customer voice recording service, senior-friendly awards, inclusive-finance language, and director training on the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. The report gives inconsistent ESG index tenure and rating statements (DJSI 'sixth consecutive year' vs 'five consecutive years'; MSCI 'AA' vs 'upgraded to A'). These do not affect scores.
